title: Kicked with Kabse Spice Dutch Chicken Paardenleverpastei
description: A tangy and energizing Dutch dish featuring kabse spice, encroute, and sugar-free friendly ingredients.
instructions: Roll out the pastry dough and place it in a 9x13 inch baking dish.
In a large skillet, cook the sliced bacon over medium-high heat until crispy. Set aside.
Add the sliced onions and bell peppers to the skillet and cook until tender.
Add the chicken breast to the skillet and cook until browned on both sides.
Sprinkle the kabse spice blend, grated cheddar cheese, and cooked bacon on top of the chicken.
Roll out the remaining pastry dough and place it on top of the filling.
Crimp the edges of the pastry and cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
Bake the pastry in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let the pastry rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
